name: Argentine Tango Lovers of Long Island
description: Argentine tango club holding Tuesday beginner and intermediate lessons, a buffet dinner and practica at Mirelle's in Westbury.
reviewNotes:
argentinetangolovers.org (as printed in the newsletter) redirects to argentinetangolovers.com. Phone/email are published on the club site under an officer's name; name not recorded.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Phone and email are the club contacts published on its own site under the president's name (name not recorded). No own studio: classes and milongas are at Mirelle's restaurant in Westbury, so only the town is recorded. The site's Instagram icon points to an Instagram location page (explore/locations/349812535161106), not an account, so no Instagram recorded. No logo on the Wix site; its only photos are a stock-style 'tango legs' picture and a Wix stock salsa image, plus a 'cancelled' flyer, so no photos taken. The current description mentions a practica; the site now describes beginner and intermediate lessons with Eran Polat, a buffet dinner and monthly milongas (no practica named) - owner may want to drop 'practica'. The vice president's phone is printed two ways on the contact page (631-266-3691 vs 631-266-9631); not recorded. The Dance Calendar venue directory (https://www.thedancecalendar.com/find-venues-events) prints a different club phone, 631.242.0686, and the old .org address; we kept the number on the club's own site.

evidence.note: Club site: Tango Tuesdays 7:00-10:30 PM at Mirelle's, 170 Post Avenue, Westbury (parking and entrance in back): beginner lesson 7:00, intermediate 7:30, buffet dinner 8:00, $35; monthly milongas; questions to (631) 495-1435.
Contact page lists the club's contact phone and s2step@aol.com and a contact form; links the club Facebook page.
